faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for GBPUAT CABM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 2 December 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for GBPUAT CABM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 2 December 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the walk-in interview for GBPUAT CABM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Office of the Dean, CABM, Pantnagar.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs. 650 per hour up to Rs. 30,000 per month (fulfilling Assistant Professor eligibility) or Rs. 550 per hour up to Rs. 25,000 per month (not fulfilling PhD eligibility).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBA with at least 60% marks or equivalent, or two years full time Post Graduate Diploma in Management from IIMs; NET/SLET in the discipline where NET/SLET is conducted (5% relaxation may be provided for SC/ST/Differently-abled at Graduate & Master's level).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. NET/SLET in the discipline where NET/SLET is conducted by ICAR/UGC/CSIR or any other Central/State Govt. Agency. NET/SLET not essential in a discipline in which NET/SLET is not conducted.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview on 02-12-2026 at 11:00 A.M. at the Office of the Dean, CABM, Pantnagar.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement on contractual basis during Second semester 2026-27. Selected candidates shall be required to join the duties immediately. Payment on hourly rate subject to a monthly maximum.

faq.answer: College of Agribusiness Management, Pantnagar.
